name: Successful Build
description: All code merged to main; CI passes; quality gates green; definition of done satisfied.
playbookRef: # no dedicated playbook — CI/CD pipeline is the gate keeper
waiverAuthority: Architecture Board (with exception for CVEs: Executive Risk Acceptance)

requiredArtifacts.validation: All technical stories Done; traceable to Functional Stories
CI run green on main branch. No failing tests, no lint errors, no security scan failures
All DoD items checked per Technical Story
Updated ADRs, inline documentation, README changes included in merge
Business logic coverage >= 80% per Quality Thresholds rules

blockingCriteria.action: BLOCK merge — fix CI before merge
BLOCK merge — add tests or request waiver
BLOCK merge — remediate CVEs or request security waiver
